concerns.text: T003 requires 'assert no NaNs' in synced.csv for the full real dataset, but FR-002 interpolates only gaps ≤ 6 h and the spec's edge cases say extreme gaps (>6 h) are 'excluded from correlation calculations'. No task defines how >6 h gaps are represented in synced.csv or excluded downstream, so the no-NaN assertion is unsatisfiable against real 23-year ACE data containing long outages. T003's verification ('the CSV has ... zero NaNs') will deterministically fail.

T002 instructs the implementer to use 'the verified CDAWeb/NOAA URLs from code/config.py', but plan.md's Data Sources section contains empty URL fields ('URL: ` (API: `)'). If code/config.py does not already contain working URLs, the task gives the implementer no canonical source to fetch from; the task should either cite the concrete URLs inline or point to where they are verifiably recorded.

T006's verification says 'a unit test asserts the flag logic on a hand-checked row' without naming the test file/test function (contrast T005, which names test_neff.py::test_neff_autocorrelation etc.). Name the test (e.g. code/tests/test_validation.py::test_flag_logic) so completion is checkable.

T009 has no verification criterion: it says to write/update research.md but names no check (file exists, links resolve to results/correlations.csv etc., sections present). Add an explicit verification, e.g. 'research.md exists and every referenced artifact path exists on disk'.

T004 validates correlations.csv against analysis_schema.schema.yaml, but output.schema.yaml defines a conflicting schema for the same artifact (composition_param/significant/effect_size_large vs composition_parameter/significance_flag/effect_size_flag) and no task reconciles or retires it. An implementer following T010's 'confirm artifact schema conformance' cannot know which contract governs.
